portfolio.idea: Personal portfolio for a product designer showcasing case studies and contact options.
portfolio.requirements:
Pages: home, about, portfolio, contact. Include a contact form and simple analytics. Primary color: #1E40AF. Font: Inter. variables:
  --radius-md: 12px
  --elev-1: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08)

product_landing.idea: SaaS product landing page focusing on conversions with pricing and FAQ.
product_landing.requirements:
Pages: home, pricing, faq. Include analytics and newsletter subscription. Primary color: #2563EB, Secondary: #F59E0B. variables:
  --color-accent: #10B981

blog.idea: Minimal personal blog with an about page and posts overview.
blog.requirements:
Pages: home, blog, about. Use a gentle accent and rounded corners. Accent color: #A855F7. variables:
  --radius-md: 14px

notes: Ocean Professional is the default theme. If you omit branding and style_overrides, defaults from /api/v1/styles are applied.
style_overrides.css_variables accepts any key listed in GET /api/v1/styles 'allowedOverrideKeys'.
style_overrides.global_css is appended to the generated assets/styles.css so be cautious with specificity.
Set options.persist_zip=true when calling POST /api/v1/generate to receive a zipUrl (absolute if BASE_URL is configured).
